name: focused-ui-scroll-seo-patch
changes: Listener profile Follow/Following is a compact action beside the profile name/status area.
Listener settings/profile/followers use one soft light page surface without large pure-white slabs, with responsive spacing on phones, tablets and desktops.
Customer bottom navigation is hidden during active or minimized calls and in every nested/subsection view; it remains visible only on the five root tabs.
Listener signup/account-creation and password-recovery screens scroll safely whenever their content is taller than the viewport.
Customer public metadata, sitemap freshness and crawl directives are strengthened for Google discovery without changing the visible public layout.
No backend source files or live call-routing logic were modified in this focused patch.
notes: This patch is intentionally limited to the requested customer/listener frontend behavior, responsive surfaces, scroll handling and public SEO metadata.
Google indexing still requires Google to crawl the deployed site; Search Console URL Inspection and sitemap submission are the supported ways to request discovery.
